title: VaultX SIMULATED CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog
disclaimer: SIMULATED subset of 20 representative CVEs for VaultX BECPL NIDS Phase 2 lab/testing.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SMBv3 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (SMBGhost)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SMBv3 compression buffer overflow allowing unauthenticated RCE on Windows 10 1903/1909.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply Microsoft security updates or disable SMBv3 compression.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: nginx HTTP/2 Data Dribble Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: HTTP/2 implementations allow excessive CPU and memory consumption via small window updates.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade nginx to patched release >= 1.16.1 / 1.17.3.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (Log4Shell)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: JNDI lookup injection allowing arbitrary remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Log4j2 to 2.17.1 or later.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (PrintNightmare)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Improper privileged file operations in Print Spooler service.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply updates and disable Print Spooler on domain controllers.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (EternalBlue)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SMBv1 server mishandles specially crafted packets enabling RCE and worm propagation.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Disable SMBv1 and apply MS17-010 updates.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability (BlueKeep)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Pre-authentication RDP use-after-free vulnerability.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply updates and enforce Network Level Authentication (NLA).

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Netlogon Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (Zerologon)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Cryptographic flaw in Netlogon allows Domain Controller takeover.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply patches and enable Netlogon enforcement mode.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Authentication bypass on administrative interface using alternate path.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade FortiOS and restrict management interface access.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Pre-authentication heap-based buffer overflow in SSL-VPN.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade FortiOS immediately.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab CE/EE Improper Validation of User-Provided Images RCE
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unauthenticated RCE via ExifTool parsing of uploaded images.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade GitLab CE/EE to patched version.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unauthenticated path traversal permitting arbitrary file read.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade GitLab CE/EE.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: args4j CLI command parser allows reading arbitrary files on Jenkins controller.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Jenkins controller and disable CLI if unused.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Progress MOVEit Transfer SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SQL injection enabling unauthorized database access and remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply vendor security patches.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Sensitive Information Disclosure (Citrix Bleed)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Buffer over-read leaking active session tokens.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply patches and terminate active sessions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Web component command injection allowing arbitrary command execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply Ivanti mitigation and upgrade.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Remote code execution via malicious Office documents invoking MSHTML.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply Microsoft updates.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Outlook Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zero-click NTLM credential leak via crafted calendar reminder.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Patch Outlook and block outbound SMB TCP/445.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence OGNL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Unauthenticated OGNL injection leading to remote code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade Confluence.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Siemens SIMATIC S7 PLC Protection Mechanism Bypass (SIMULATED KEV Entry)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Weak cryptographic protection on industrial PLC communication channels.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Restrict VLAN 30 access and upgrade PLC firmware during scheduled plant maintenance.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: WinRAR Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Crafted archive executes arbitrary code when benign file entry is opened.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Upgrade WinRAR to version 6.23 or later.
